# Humble Beeing

> Humble Beeing is a Kampala-based Ugandan producer of raw honey, infused honeys, beeswax candles, and gift hampers made with smallholder beekeepers. The linked UNBS chemistry and microbiology reports cover one raw honey sample tested in October 2025; they do not establish results for every batch.

## Products

Full range with listed prices, tasting notes, pairings, and FAQs: https://www.humble-beeing.com/products. Confirm current price and availability before ordering.

Raw single-origin honey (350g jars; confirm current prices on product pages):
- [Yumbe Shea Blossom Honey](https://www.humble-beeing.com/products/yumbe-shea-blossom-honey) — best seller; buttery caramel monofloral honey from the West Nile shea belt
- [Nebbi Multifloral Honey](https://www.humble-beeing.com/products/nebbi-multifloral-honey) — dark, complex wild-forage honey
- [Arua Calliandra Blossom Honey](https://www.humble-beeing.com/products/arua-calliandra-honey) — light, delicate floral honey

Infused honey (350g jars; confirm current prices on product pages):
- [Vanilla Bean](https://www.humble-beeing.com/products/vanilla-bean-infused-honey) — best seller; aged with whole locally sourced Ugandan vanilla pods
- [Rosemary](https://www.humble-beeing.com/products/rosemary-infused-honey) — best seller; savoury-sweet, the cook's favourite
- [Lemon Peel](https://www.humble-beeing.com/products/lemon-peel-infused-honey) — infused with lemon peel
- [Orange Peel](https://www.humble-beeing.com/products/orange-peel-infused-honey) — marmalade notes, baker's and bartender's jar
- [Scotch Bonnet Chilli](https://www.humble-beeing.com/products/scotch-bonnet-chilli-infused-honey) — Uganda's hot honey, for pizza and fried chicken
- [Garlic](https://www.humble-beeing.com/products/garlic-infused-honey) — savoury garlic infusion

Candles, cosmetics and gifts:
- [Natural Beeswax Candle — Lemongrass & Ginger](https://www.humble-beeing.com/products/beeswax-candle), hand-poured in Kampala
- [Natural Beeswax Candle — Lavender, Chamomile & Vanilla](https://www.humble-beeing.com/products/lavender-chamomile-vanilla-beeswax-candle), hand-poured in Kampala
- [Natural Beeswax Lip Care](https://www.humble-beeing.com/products/beeswax-lip-balm): beeswax, shea butter, and coconut oil
- [Honey Taster Gift Set](https://www.humble-beeing.com/products/taster-gift-set) — weddings, kwanjula/kukyala introduction ceremonies, corporate gifting
- Wholesale and bulk honey for chefs, hotels, retailers, and NGOs

## Where to buy

- Ask about orders and delivery: https://www.humble-beeing.com/contact-and-connect

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.humble-beeing.com/): brand overview and products

- [Our Story](https://www.humble-beeing.com/our-story): the family and mission behind the brand
- [Our Process](https://www.humble-beeing.com/our-process): how the honey is harvested and processed
- [Lab Tests](https://www.humble-beeing.com/lab-tests): original UNBS chemistry and microbiology reports for one 2025 raw honey sample
- [Impact & Sustainability](https://www.humble-beeing.com/impact-and-sustainability): poverty alleviation, biodiversity, gender inclusion
- [Wholesale & Partnerships](https://www.humble-beeing.com/wholesale-and-partnerships): bulk supply and corporate gifting
- [Blog](https://www.humble-beeing.com/blog): guides on Ugandan honey, candles, and gifting
